notes.title: Patch Notes - V1.1
notes.content:
Patch notes v1.1
September 5th 2024

The Doors

 An Interaction tool tip was added indicating when a door can be knocked-on by pressing E. This was something player’s didn’t realise they could do when exploring the hamlet.
 Bug fixed where player’s would occasionally be locked out of certain rooms they needed to be inside
 Bug fixed where certain doors would only open halfway


The Wolves

 Fixed a bug where the wolf fight wouldn’t trigger.


Audio 

 Reduced the volume of the wolf howl and converted the audio to 3D
 General dialogue audio balancing and drop-off calibration
 Improvements to the spacing and sound of the footsteps
 Background noise during the dinner scene improved
 Fixed a bug where certain dialogue was missing audio
 General audio balancing improvements
 Separated volume sliders on the menu screen to Master, Dialogue, Sound effects, Music
 Fixed a bug where certain dialogue would ramp-squeak when starting


tHe cArT

 The cart’s mass was increased to reduce the chance that it would flip
 Fixed a bug where the player could attach themselves to the cart


The Rewind Mechanics

 Improvement to the smoothness and speed of memory transitions of the rewind potion
 Rewind motion now implemented into the first rewind of the game
 Alana’s rewind options properly defined


Lighting

 Added a fade-out fade-in to the Day 1 Day 2 transition
 Smoother time of day changes improving lighting transition during the dinner scene


The Environment

 The river can now not be entered
 The player cannot fall off the map during the lion fight dream sequence.
 Fixed a bug where the player could see themselves in the looped edges.
 The signs are hard to read
 The Alchemist has 2 carts and takes the one from the player's house
 The Alchemist has been slowed so he arrives to the Frankie scene a bit later


The Barrel Bashing

 The player’s attacks are now stronger, making the barrels easier to knock down


Conversation

 Misc conversation bugs fixed and quality of life improvements
 Rewind options are now shown in pink when unlocked
 Improved how characters look at eachother when speaking
 Improved Alana’s head dunking animation
 Alana no longer continues to dunk her head after the player tells the dad about the sword
 Fixed a bug where the game would soft lock when the player tells the dad about the sword
 Fixed a bug where you couldn’t make the dad angry with a right click attack
 Fixed a bug where you could knock on other doors after speaking to Alana in day 2
